import sys


def main():
    jobs = []
    for line in sys.stdin:
        parts = line.strip().split()
        if parts:
            name, arrival, duration, priority = parts
            jobs.append((name, int(arrival), int(duration), int(priority)))
    jobs.sort(key=lambda j: (-j[3], j[1], j[0]))
    time = 0
    idle = 0
    scheduled = []
    while jobs:
        candidates = [job for job in jobs if job[1] <= time]
        if not candidates:
            idle += time - (scheduled[-1][1] if scheduled else 0)
            time += 1
            continue
        best = max(candidates, key=lambda x: (-x[3], x[1], x[0]))
        scheduled.append(best)
        time = best[1]
        print(best[0], time, time + best[2])
    print("idle", idle)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
